description: This file defines traits and functions for handling SQL page parameters and results, including conversion from string arguments, parsing, and serialization for database interactions.

classes.name: SqlPageFunctionParam
classes.description: A wrapper struct for parameters that implement BorrowFromStr, used for parsing SQL page parameters.

classes.name: IntoCow
classes.description: A trait for converting various types into an Option<Cow<'a, str>> for SQL serialization.

methods.name: as_sql
methods.description: Converts an optional string parameter into an SQL-safe string, handling NULL values.

methods.name: from_args
methods.description: Trait method to parse function arguments from an iterator of optional string references.

methods.name: borrow_from_str
methods.description: Trait method to parse a Cow<'a, str> into a specific type, with error handling.

methods.name: into_cow
methods.description: Converts a value into an Option<Cow<'a, str>> for SQL output.
